name: Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter
description: The Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter, also known as the Ginivex series and the Geonosian fanblade starfighter, was a model of starfighter manufactured by Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective. It was flown by Sith apprentice and Separatist commander Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. The ship was equipped with a solar sail, which granted it greater speed and shielding at the cost of allowing other ships' sensors to more easily detect the fighter.
